title: Location Tracking & GPS Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template letter to request deletion of your location data from apps and services. Protect your GPS privacy with this easy-to-use template.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request companies delete your stored location data, stop tracking your movements, and respect your GPS privacy rights. Includes legal references and customizable sections.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information

placeholders.label: Company Name
placeholders.defaultValue: Name of the company tracking your location

sections.heading: Subject Line and Account Identification
Specific Data Deletion Requests
sections.content:
I specifically request that you:

1. Delete all stored location data associated with my account, including:
 - GPS coordinates and timestamps
 - Location history and movement patterns
 - Geofence data and location-based triggers
 - Wi-Fi and Bluetooth beacon data
 - IP address location mapping

2. Remove my data from any location-based advertising profiles
3. Delete location data shared with third-party partners
4. Permanently disable location tracking for my account going forward

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Privacy Laws
sections.content:
This request is made under my privacy rights including:

- California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) right to deletion
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) right to erasure (if applicable)
- State privacy laws in {{your_state}}
- Your company's privacy policy commitments

I do not consent to any further collection, processing, or sharing of my location data for any purpose including marketing, analytics, or third-party services.

sections.heading: Timeline and Confirmation Requirements
sections.content:
Please confirm completion of this request within 30 days and provide:

1. Written confirmation that my location data has been deleted
2. Confirmation that location tracking has been disabled
3. List of any third parties who received my location data
4. Steps taken to notify those third parties of this deletion request

If you cannot fulfill this request, please explain the specific legal basis for retaining my location data.
